svg.title: What Spead AI does
svg.desc: AI Partner chat: Streaming chat that answers from the company's own documents and shows citations next to each answer. Doc Assistant: Ask questions over uploaded documents. Retrieval uses vector search with reranking, so answers come from the right passages. Knowledge Hub with approval: Upload documents, then approve, reject or re-index them. Only approved material reaches the AI. Document Studio: A guided flow from discussion to outline to finished document, with an editor for documents, slide decks and infographics. Templates and letterheads: Template Studio lets teams design reusable templates and letterheads, so output follows internal format. Export to four formats: A separate export engine renders PDF, PNG, PPTX and DOCX files from the same document. Collaboration: Share documents, see who is present, comment, and get live updates. It uses soft locks, not character-level merging, by design. Connectors, Channels, Schedules: Link external systems over MCP, Microsoft 365, read-only SQL and REST. Reach the agent through chat channels and run scheduled jobs.
svg.text: The parts of Spead AI people use every day.
